description: This file contains asynchronous functions for managing Jira issues linked to messages within a system. It includes features for ensuring the existence of Jira issues for messages, adding comments, and recording synchronization statuses. The code interacts with a Jira client, database models, and performs audit logging.

methods.name: Optional[str] ensure_issue_for_message( db: Session, message_id: UUID, *, project_key: Optional[str] = None, issue_type: str = "Task", )
methods.description: Asynchronously ensures a Jira issue exists for a given message, creating or verifying the issue as needed.

methods.name: bool add_comment_for_message(db: Session, message_id: UUID, comment: str)
methods.description: Adds a comment to the Jira issue linked to a message, creating the issue if it does not already exist.

methods.name: JiraSync record_sync_status(db: Session, jira_issue_id: str, message_id: Optional[UUID], status: JiraSyncStatus, *, details: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Records the synchronization status of a Jira issue, with optional audit logging.

methods.name: JiraSync _link_sync_record(db: Session, message_id: Optional[UUID], jira_issue_id: str, status: JiraSyncStatus)
methods.description: Creates or updates a JiraSync record linking a Jira issue and a message, updating sync status and timestamp.

methods.name: str _make_summary_from_content(content: str, max_len: int = 120)
methods.description: Generates a summary string from message content, truncated to a maximum length.

ctags.signature: (db: Session, message_id: Optional[UUID], jira_issue_id: str, status: JiraSyncStatus)
